-- intro: Ultra Giant Bull is a recombination-based Compound Magic spell.
-- Description:
    The Mirror Magic user multiplies the Transmutation Magic user who then converts a large structure nearby into the same material as the Recombination Magic user's magic house. This converted material is combined into the magic house, creating an even more gigantic bull. At the same time, the Poison Magic user casts Curse-Worker's Neighbor on a cursed individual in order to absorb an enemy's magic through the gigantic bull. The Recombination Magic user can create a central cockpit where allies can lend their strengths while being protected by the base. Numerous cannons can be opened all over its body and fire beams of magic, which can arc around corners if needed. This spell requires a large amount of magic power due to the amount of material being manipulated.
